description.ko: 아무도 두고 가지 않아요. 내가 위험해도요.
description.en: You leave no one behind. Even if it costs you.
description.de: Du lässt niemanden zurück. Auch wenn's dich was kostet.

description.ko: 계획은 없어요. 운과 친구 복으로 어떻게든 살아남죠.
description.en: No plan. Pure luck and friends. Somehow, it works.
description.de: Kein Plan. Nur Glück und Freunde. Klappt trotzdem.

description.en: You grab the map and march everyone to victory.
description.de: Du schnappst dir die Karte und führst alle zum Sieg.

description.en: You find the loophole. Even the guards are confused.
description.de: Du findest die Lücke. Sogar die Wachen sind verwirrt.

description.en: You feed everyone and build the alliance.
description.de: Du kümmerst dich um alle und schmiedest Bündnisse.

description.en: Even here, you make people laugh.
description.de: Selbst hier bringst du alle zum Lachen.

description.ko: 누구보다 빨리 규칙을 익히고 판 전체를 관리해요.
description.en: You learn the rules fastest and run the whole game.
description.de: Du lernst die Regeln am schnellsten und leitest das ganze Spiel.

description.en: Body first, brain later. You shine in chaos.
description.de: Erst handeln, dann denken. Im Chaos glänzt du.

description.en: You saw everyone's true heart. And the ending.
description.de: Du hast jedes Herz durchschaut. Und das Ende.

description.ko: 흔들려도 결정적 순간엔 가장 용감해요. 당신이 주인공이에요.
description.en: Shaken, but brave when it counts. You're the main character.
description.de: Wackelig, aber mutig, wenn's zählt. Du bist die Hauptfigur.

description.ko: 게임이 시작되기도 전에 전부 계산해 뒀죠.
description.en: You calculated everything. Before the game even started.
description.de: Du hast alles berechnet. Bevor das Spiel begann.

description.ko: 돌은 왜 가라앉지? 시간 끝나기 직전까지 분석했죠.
description.en: Why do stones sink? You had to know. Right before time ran out.
description.de: Warum sinken Steine? Du musstest es wissen. Kurz vor Schluss.

description.ko: 묵묵히 곁을 지켜요. 그 착함이 당신의 힘이에요.
description.en: You stay by their side. Your kindness is your power.
description.de: Du bleibst an ihrer Seite. Deine Güte ist deine Stärke.

description.ko: 싸움을 피해서 내 속도로 끝까지 버텨요.
description.en: You skip the fights and survive at your own pace.
description.de: Du meidest Streit und überlebst in deinem Tempo.

description.en: Step by step, rule by rule. Zero surprises.
description.de: Schritt für Schritt, Regel für Regel. Null Überraschungen.

description.ko: 말은 적어도 손은 완벽해요. 위기에 가장 침착하죠.
description.en: Few words, perfect hands. Calmest in a crisis.
description.de: Wenig Worte, perfekte Hände. Ruhig in jeder Krise.
